OperationStep.Description: Delete the generated source schema workspace so extraction can be replayed.
OperationStep.Name: remove-source-schema

OperationStep.Description: Create the source MetaSchema workspace from the live AdventureWorks2022 database.
OperationStep.Name: extract-schema

OperationStep.Arguments: execute --connection-env {env:AW_SOURCE_SQL} --query "SET NOCOUNT ON; SELECT 'AdventureWorks OLTP source OK' AS Status; SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS SalesOrderHeaderRows FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader; SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS SalesOrderDetailRows FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail; SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS ProductRows FROM Production.Product; SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS CustomerRows FROM Sales.Customer; SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS StoreRows FROM Sales.Store;"
OperationStep.Description: Connect through AW_SOURCE_SQL and query representative source tables.
OperationStep.Name: query-source
